units.source_text: 随从诸人闻知即可返京，将与父母妻小团聚，各自欢欣。

en.t: When the attendants heard that they could return to the capital at once and be reunited with their parents, wives, and children, each of them rejoiced.

units.source_text: 京中派来迎接的人也到了。

en.t: The people sent from the capital to escort them home had also arrived.

units.source_text: 人人喜形于色，只有主人明石道人涕泪满襟。

en.t: Everyone's joy showed on their faces; only their host, the Akashi monk, had his sleeves soaked with tears.

units.source_text: 匆匆到了仲秋八月，天地也带了哀愁之色。

en.t: Before long, the eighth month of mid-autumn had arrived, and even heaven and earth seemed tinged with sorrow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子怅望长空，方寸缭乱，想道：“我为什么自寻烦恼，以致自昔至今，常为无聊之事而折磨身心？”

en.t: Prince Genji gazed wistfully into the wide sky, his heart in turmoil, and thought, "Why do I seek out troubles for myself, so that from the past until now I have so often tormented my body and mind over trivial things?"

units.source_text: 几个知心的随从者看到这般光景，相与叹道：“怎么办呢？

en.t: Several trusted attendants saw him in this state and sighed to one another, "What can be done?
His old weakness has flared up again."

units.source_text: 又私下议论：“几个月以来，绝不让人注目，有时难得悄悄地前去，关系本是淡然的；

en.t: They also whispered among themselves, "For these past few months he took great care not to attract notice, and only rarely slipped over there in secret; the relationship had seemed quite casual.

units.source_text: 岂料近来不顾一切，频频往来，这反教那女的受苦呢。”

en.t: Who would have expected that lately he would cast everything aside and go back and forth so often? This only makes that woman suffer."

units.source_text: 他们又谈到此事的起因，都说是少纳言良清昔年在北山首先提及这个女子。

en.t: They also spoke of how the affair had begun, and all said that years earlier, at Kitayama, the Lesser Counselor Yoshikiyo had been the first to mention this woman.

units.source_text: 良清听了心中好生不快。

en.t: When Yoshikiyo heard this, he felt deeply displeased.
